battlefields.name: Sunken Temple
battlefields.official_html: When you conquer here with one or more [Mighty] units, you may pay :rb_energy_1: to draw 1. (A unit is Mighty while it has 5+ :rb_might:.)

battlefields.name: Seat of Power
battlefields.official_html: When you conquer here, draw 1 for each other battlefield you or allies control..

battlefields.name: Minefield
battlefields.official_html: When you conquer here, put the top 2 cards of your Main Deck into your trash.

battlefields.name: Void Gate
battlefields.official_html: Spells and abilities affecting units here each deal 1 Bonus Damage. (Each instance of damage the spell deals is increased by 1.)
battlefields.corrected_text: Spells and abilities deal 1 Bonus Damage to units here. (Each instance of damage the spell deals to a unit here is increased by 1.)

battlefields.name: The Academy
battlefields.official_html: When you hold here, give your next spell this turn [Repeat] equal to its base cost. (You may pay the additional cost to repeat the spell's effect.)
battlefields.official_text: When you hold here, give your next spell this turn [Repeat] equal to its base cost. (You may pay the additional cost to repeat the spell's effect.)

battlefields.name: Firelights' Hideout
battlefields.official_html: When you conquer here, the next unit you play this turn has [Accelerate]. (You may pay :rb_energy_1: and a Power of its Domain as an additional cost to have it enter ready.)
battlefields.official_text: When you conquer here, the next unit you play this turn has [Accelerate]. (You may pay [1 Energy] and a Power of its Domain as an additional cost to have it enter ready.)

battlefields.name: Ornn's Forge
battlefields.official_html: While you control this battlefield, the first friendly non-token gear played each turn costs :rb_energy_1: less.
battlefields.official_text: While you control this battlefield, the first friendly non-token gear played each turn costs [1 Energy] less.

battlefields.name: Hunters' Circle
battlefields.official_html: For each player, the first unit or gear they play here on their turn costs :rb_energy_1: less.
battlefields.official_text: For each player, the first unit or gear they play here on their turn costs [1 Energy] less.

battlefields.name: Piltovan Forge
battlefields.official_html: While you control this battlefield, the first friendly gear activated ability played each turn costs :rb_energy_1: less.
battlefields.official_text: While you control this battlefield, the first friendly gear activated ability played each turn costs [1 Energy] less.

battlefields.name: Risen Altar
battlefields.official_html: [Empower] costs of your units here cost :rb_energy_1: or :rb_rune_rainbow: less.
battlefields.official_text: [Empower] costs of your units here cost [1 Energy] or [Any Power] less.

battlefields.name: Vaults of Helia
battlefields.official_html: When you hold here, your non-token units cost :rb_energy_1: more to play this turn.
battlefields.official_text: When you hold here, your non-token units cost [1 Energy] more to play this turn.
